Intervals between consecutive dated doses

Source: R/curves.R
derive_dose_intervals.Rd

For every dose with a previous_dose in the schedule, the number of days between the two doses when both carry usable card dates. Nothing is computed for a pair with a missing or partial date.

derive_dose_intervals(x, schedule = NULL)

Arguments

x

A vcs_data object.

schedule

A vcs_schedule(); defaults to the one stored in x.

Value

A tibble with child_id, antigen, from, to, interval_days, scheduled_interval_days and the child-level columns of x.

See also

table_dose_intervals(), compute_cic()

Examples

head(derive_dose_intervals(vcs_example))
